name: Tm Visualization Suite: Hierarchy Explorer
pitch: Show part-to-whole and parent-child structure across up to eight levels with five layouts.
question: How does the whole divide into parts at each level of the hierarchy?
useWhen: Show a hierarchy when each row is a full path from the root.
features: Show the share of each node in a round sunburst.
Keep long labels in rectangles with an icicle.
Nest each node as a circle inside its parent.
Read the tree structure without a measure in a dendrogram.
Show a large tree in a round radial dendrogram.
Select the full path of a node from the root level down.

hero.alt: Sunburst of product sales from department down to product name, with one ring for each level.

screenshots.alt: Icicle chart of the product assortment with one rectangle for each node and a label where it fits.
screenshots.caption: Read the hierarchy in rectangles with long labels.

screenshots.alt: Radial dendrogram of the product assortment, with the tree drawn around a centre.
screenshots.caption: Show a large tree in a round layout.
